title: python3 -m venv (with ensurepip) fails on the mounted folder
observed: python3 -m venv tools/venv exited after ~67 s with: Command ['.../tools/venv/bin/python3','-m','ensurepip','--upgrade','--default-pip'] returned non-zero exit status 1. python3 -m venv --without-pip succeeds in 0.3 s and 'python3 -m pip --python tools/venv/bin/python install ...' installs splat64[mips] etc. in 47 s.
hypothesis: ensurepip's wheel bootstrap writes or renames files in a way the mount refuses (the mount refuses unlink); not verified.
